texts.zh:
试图通过与[event_target:solarpunk_country.GetSpeciesAdj]合作来获取超空间航道技术知识的进度一直缓慢得令人沮丧。要想像他们一样掌握局域超空间航道群，我们似乎需要花费数千年的时间来编制超空间波动的目录。我们收到了他们首席代表的新信息。

“老实说，你们在这里让我们越来越不舒服了，既然我们已经帮你们完成了来这里的目的，我们得请你们离开。我们判断你我双方的生活方式不可相容，担心你们在未来可能会觊觎我们拥有的东西。为了避免显得过于粗鲁，我们愿意送给你们一颗星球。我们会负责运输的，不用担心。”
texts.en:
The insights we have gained into hyperlane technology through our cooperation with the [event_target:solarpunk_country.GetSpeciesAdj] has been frustratingly slow. It seems that to achieve the mastery of a local hyperlane cluster like they have, we would need to spend thousands of years cataloging hyper-fluctuations. We have received a new communication from their chief representative.

"To be honest, your presence here has been grating, so now that we have taught you what you came for, we need to ask you to leave. Having judged that our ways of life are incompatible, we worry that you might covet what we have in the future. So to prevent any feelings of ill will, we wish to offer you one of our worlds. We will handle the transportation, don't worry."

label.en: We accept, have a good life.

tooltips.zh: 太阳 X将添加到[capital_star.GetName]轨道内。
tooltips.en: Sol X will be added in orbit around [capital_star.GetName].

label.zh: 我们要夺走你们的秘密！

tooltips.zh: 侵略这些外星人，获得超空间航道的秘密。
tooltips.en: Invade the aliens to learn the secrets of the hyperlanes.

texts.zh:
我们以为那些能够穿越星空的人不会如此原始地诉诸暴力。

请离开。
texts.en:
We thought those who could traverse the stars wouldn't be so primitive as to resort to violence.

Leave.

tooltips.zh:
我们在[From.solar_system.GetName]星系的所有舰船都在行动中失踪了。
所有通往[From.solar_system.GetName]星系的超空间航道都变得很不稳定。
tooltips.en:
All our ships in the [From.solar_system.GetName] system have gone missing in action.
All Hyperlanes to the [From.solar_system.GetName] system have become unstable.
